name: Distributed Memory Caching System with Load Balancing
aliases: Logical Global Address Space with Caching
definition: A distributed memory caching system that manages storage, communication, and caching of volume blocks across N nodes. It uses a central master process to coordinate cache contents and assigns blocks to nodes for projection and composition to minimize communication.
summary: This system minimizes communication overhead in volume rendering by assigning fixed screen regions to nodes and prioritizing block assignment to nodes that already hold a copy, eliminating tile transfer costs.
